description: This file defines a class 'SearchViewAlwaysVisible' that extends 'SearchViewActionBar'. It demonstrates the usage of an always-expanded SearchView in an Android application's ActionBar as a menu item, with suggestions and query submission capabilities.

classes.name: SearchViewAlwaysVisible
classes.description: A subclass of SearchViewActionBar that configures the SearchView to always be expanded in the ActionBar.

methods.name: isAlwaysExpanded
methods.description: Overrides the method to return true, ensuring that the SearchView is always expanded.
